sections.text:
FLEX
-2 (
The Flame Extinguishment 
-
 2) experiment is the second experiment to fly on the 
ISS which
 uses small droplets of fuel to study the special spherical characteristics of burning fuel droplets in space. 
The investigation has 40 Experiment Data 
records which
 are based on the Test Matrix (
Binary Array
, 
Condensed Phase
, 
LCTFCalibration
, 
LCTFWavelengths
, 
Quiescent
, 
RadiometerCalibration
, 
SurrotgateFuel
), Fuel Composition, and/or Year
. 
These Experiment Data records are located on the “Data” tab within the FLEX
-2
 investigation in PSI. 
When a
n experiment data
 record is selected, the “Scientific Data
 a
nd Information” tab is opened. 
The
 Experiment Data record
’s
 
“Raw Data” and 
“Images” 
are organized
 by 
test point
. 
The “Raw Data
”
 link
s
 disp
lay records for the 
Raw & Analyzed Data 
within the specific 
test point.
  
When a Raw & Analyzed D
ata record is selected, there will be the following tabs: “General”, 
“Raw Data and Information”, and “Comments”. 
The
 “Raw Data and Information” will contain .txt files of the experiment’s raw data. 
The
 “Images”
 link
s
 displays records for each
 
Videos & Images record
 
within the specific
 test point
.  
An “Image Data”
 tab within this 
record
 provides an Image Gallery with thumbnail 
images
,
 a .zip file provides the original images
, and an image document with more information on the images
.
